title: Sheng-Yun Brian Yu CV
subtitle: Full-Stack Engineer · 8 years across backend, frontend, and engineering management; iterating faster with AI-assisted development

description.intro:
Hello, I am Sheng-Yun Yu (Brian Yu), a full-stack engineer with around 8 years of experience. Node.js / TypeScript and NestJS on the backend, React / Next.js on the frontend — able to take a product line from schema design and APIs through the interface to deployment on my own.

At a gaming and live-streaming platform I moved from backend engineer to engineering manager, owning the microservice architecture, high-concurrency traffic, and the team's development standards.

Over the past six months AI-assisted development has shortened my iteration cycle: requirements start from verifiable completion criteria, implementation runs as agent iteration, and tests and code review pass through AI first. I also know what taking AI to production actually requires — guardrails, degradation paths, offline evaluation, and cost accounting. One engineer completed two product lines in six months, shipping six Claude features and a RAG support agent.

I am seeking a full-stack engineer, senior backend, or engineering manager position.
